description: This file implements a custom ILoggerProvider called FileLoggerProvider that logs messages to a file, along with extension methods to add this provider to an ILoggingBuilder. It defines classes for producing loggers that output to files and configuring the logging system with this provider.

classes.name: FileLoggerProvider
classes.description: Provides loggers that output log messages to a specified file. Implements ILoggerProvider.

classes.name: FileLoggerProviderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension method for ILoggingBuilder to easily add FileLoggerProvider.

methods.name: FileLoggerProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new FileLoggerProvider with specified log file path.

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates a new FileLogger for the given category.

methods.name: AddFile
methods.description: Extension method to add a FileLoggerProvider to the ILoggingBuilder.
